mission: WI-2: Cron + background jobs final audit (inventory + scheduling coverage + retry/DLQ pattern consistency)
head: 1e7c65ecc
summary: Schedule has 15 entries (13 commands + 2 jobs + 1 inline closure), mutex/onOneServer coverage is 100%, retry+DLQ patterns are well-formed for the 2 main Job classes, BUT the 30-file Console/Commands/ tree contains 2 silent architectural drifts in non-fiscal scheduler closures that mirror the FISCAL-ADV3B-01 / Wave 2d FISCAL-ADV3C-01 bug class (where('status', 1) ignoring Status::ACTIVE=5 post-migration). Inventory of 30 commands is otherwise clean: 13 scheduled, 17 manual-only/seed/UAT (verified by signature prefix).

scheduled_lanes.name: purge-expired-otps
scheduled_lanes.command_or_class: DELETE FROM otps WHERE created_at < now-(expire+1)m
scheduled_lanes.mutex: withoutOverlapping() — NOTE: missing onOneServer() (only lane without cross-host serialization, see WI-2-SRE-08)

manual_only_commands: fiscal:verify-chain (on-demand, also used by scheduler closure)
foodking:fiscal:archive (on-demand, also used by scheduler closure)
inventory.horizon_supervisor_alignment: production: supervisor-high serves [high] tries=6 timeout=90; supervisor-default serves [default,notifications] tries=3 timeout=90. DispatchDomainEventsJob has $tries=6 (matches high). SendFcmNotificationJob has $tries=3 (matches default+notifications). ProcessWebhookEventJob has $tries=3 (matches default). NO MISMATCH detected.

findings.title: Two cron lanes silently no-op post Status::ACTIVE migration (FISCAL-ADV3B-01 sibling)
findings.evidence: Kernel.php:268-294 documents that activeBranchIds() exists precisely because of the pending data migration UPDATE branches SET status=5 WHERE status=1. Fiscal lanes (chain monitor + daily archive) were retrofitted in Wave 2d FISCAL-ADV3C-01 to use whereIn('status',[Status::ACTIVE,1]). But SloEvaluatorJob:48 still has Branch::query()->where('status', 1)->get() AND StockScanRupture::targetBranches() at line 168 still has $query->where('status', 1)->get(). When the data migration runs (owner-flagged pending), both crons silently iterate an empty branch set: every 5min SLO sweep blanks, every 5min auto-86 cron stops flipping rupture rows. Same exact bug class FISCAL-ADV3B-01 was opened to close.
findings.impact: Post-migration: (a) SLO alerts go dark — no breach detection across any branch; (b) Auto-86 preventive cron silently disables itself — items whose stockable variations all hit 0 stay 'available' between orders until a real customer hits the reactive path.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace both with self::activeBranchIds() in Kernel + dependency injection OR with whereIn('status',[Status::ACTIVE,1]) inline. Mirror the pattern at PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php:39 the Kernel docstring already references.
findings.cross_ref: WI-2-RED-01 documents this from the adversarial angle; same fix closes both.

findings.title: OutboxRescueCommand inconsistent with retry-failed siblings — no LOCK_KEY, no BATCH_CAP, no audit trail
findings.evidence: OutboxRetryFailedCommand (Wave 3b/3c heal) and OutboxWebhookRetryFailedCommand (Sprint H3 + Wave 3c) both adopted: (1) Cache::lock LOCK_KEY + LOCK_TTL_SECONDS=300, (2) BATCH_CAP=500 with orderBy('id'), (3) per-event try/catch with audit_log.write before dispatch, (4) structured Log::channel('fiscal') summary. OutboxRescueCommand has NONE of these — it runs every minute with a bare DomainEvent::query()->stale(2)->where('attempts','<',5)->get() then for-each dispatches. The mutex on Kernel.php:42 (withoutOverlapping()) is the only guard, which protects against re-entry per host but not against batch unboundedness or audit gap.
findings.impact: Architectural inconsistency — three sibling commands solving the same problem with three different rigor levels. Operationally low-severity in steady state because rescue events are sparse (attempts<5 stale-by-2-min), but a worker-down scenario followed by recovery would produce one rescue tick that re-queues an unbounded set. Bigger concern: rescue does not audit_log the replay, while retry-failed does (Wave 3 SYNC-ADV3-04). NF525-adjacent inconsistency.
findings.fix_sketch: Add Cache::lock guard + take(500) + per-event audit_log.write — mirror the OutboxRetryFailedCommand::runHandle skeleton verbatim. Lock key 'outbox.rescue.lock'. TTL 60s OK because batch is bounded once the cap is in. See WI-2-RED-02 for the saturation angle.
findings.cross_ref: Sister of WI-2-RED-02; the RED-team angle adds the queue-saturation scenario.

findings.title: CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders lacks per-order isolation (WG-2 listener-isolation pattern not propagated)
findings.evidence: The job at line 42 wraps the entire per-order block in ->each(function ($order) { DB::transaction(...) ... 4 dispatches }) with NO try/catch around the closure. Compare to OutboxRetryFailedCommand:86-134 which has explicit try/catch + continue per event, and WG-2 P1 heal which split 4 listeners into independent failure boundaries. One throwing order (e.g. transient lockForUpdate timeout, OrderStateMachine invariant violation surfacing) aborts the batch and abandons the remaining stale orders for the next 5-minute cron tick. Over a long outage the backlog compounds.
findings.impact: Low under happy path; medium under DB-pressure or schema-drift conditions. WG-2 already taught the codebase this lesson for listeners; the same discipline must propagate to batch-mode jobs.
findings.fix_sketch: Wrap the inner closure in try { ... } catch (\Throwable $e) { Log::error('cleanup_stale.order_failed', [...]); continue; }. Idempotency is already DB-row-level via lockForUpdate + status guard, so retry on next tick is safe.

findings.title: schedule->call inline closures in Kernel are not unit-testable
findings.evidence: Three scheduler entries use inline closures that wrap Artisan::call() inside try/catch around an iteration. The Kernel.php:282-285 docstring on activeBranchIds() acknowledges 'a future test can substitute a fake Branch model and assert iteration semantics without touching the scheduler closure (which Laravel does not run from Schedule::events() in a unit-testable way).' This is a known limitation, not a bug — but documenting that it's deliberate, not an oversight, justifies a P3 note rather than a P2 finding.
findings.impact: Coverage gap, not a correctness gap. Sentinel tests can target activeBranchIds() and the underlying commands (fiscal:verify-chain, foodking:fiscal:archive) directly, leaving the closure-level orchestration untested.
findings.fix_sketch: Extract each closure into a thin invokable class App\Console\Schedulers\FiscalChainMonitorScheduler under the same namespace, register it via $schedule->job(new FiscalChainMonitorScheduler) or $schedule->call([app(FiscalChainMonitorScheduler::class), '__invoke']). Not blocking V1.

retry_dlq.DispatchDomainEventsJob: GOOD — $tries=6, $backoff=[1,5,15,60,300], $this->fail() short-circuit for PayloadMismatchException (F-3 quick win 2026-05-19), structured failed() callback writes last_error + log.error
retry_dlq.ProcessWebhookEventJob: GOOD — $tries=3, $backoff=[10,60,300], idempotent short-circuit on STATUS_PROCESSED, markFailed() before rethrow
retry_dlq.SendFcmNotificationJob: GOOD — $tries=3, backoff() method returns [10,30], dedicated 'notifications' queue (NEW-03), structured failed() log
retry_dlq.CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders: OK — non-ShouldQueue (synchronous scheduler job), but lacks per-order isolation (see WI-2-ARCH-03)
retry_dlq.SloEvaluatorJob: GOOD — $tries=3, $backoff=10, per-branch try/catch (W9-AUDIT FIX-6), but see WI-2-ARCH-01 for branch-selection bug

idempotency.DispatchDomainEventsJob: Atomic Phase 1 claim under lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard — second worker observes already-claimed and returns silently
idempotency.ProcessWebhookEventJob: STATUS_PROCESSED short-circuit covers concurrent live-endpoint replay
idempotency.RetryFiscalAllocCommand: Delegates to FrontendOrderService::finalizePaidKioskOrder which has its own lockForUpdate (verified service line 1088); 5-min withoutOverlapping mutex is belt-and-suspenders
idempotency.Prune commands (outbox + webhook): Idempotent — second invocation matches an empty set per docstring
idempotency.OutboxRetryFailedCommand: Cache::lock + deterministic orderBy('id') ensure overlap-safe replay
idempotency.OutboxWebhookRetryFailedCommand: Same as above with distinct LOCK_KEY

under_instrumented: OutboxRescueCommand — no Log::info summary, only $this->info to stdout (see WI-2-SRE-02)
OutboxRetryFailedCommand — has audit_log writes but no per-run Log::channel summary (asymmetric with webhook sibling)
RetryFiscalAllocCommand — per-event success/failure logged, but no per-tick summary aggregate
PosPurgeParkedOrders — no Log call at all

non_findings_verified: Mutex coverage: 15/15 scheduled entries have withoutOverlapping. onOneServer coverage: 14/15 — the otp-purge inline closure at Kernel.php:34 chains only withoutOverlapping (see WI-2-SRE-08 P2 finding). All other lanes chain BOTH primitives per the W9-AUDIT FIX-6 standard.

Manual-only command classification: 17 commands have non-cron signatures (seeders, ensure-*, e2e-stress, preflight, simulate, menu-heal). Owner-validated as manual-only via their existing usage patterns.

FiscalArchiveCommand TZ-safety: config('app.timezone') = 'Europe/Paris', so Carbon::parse() in handle() resolves to Paris boundaries (Laravel's bootstrap sets date_default_timezone_set from app.timezone). Daily archive --from=$yesterday --to=$yesterday is Paris-day-aligned. NOT a WH-3 sibling.
Horizon supervisor tries alignment: $tries on each Job matches the supervisor that serves its queue (high=6, default+notifications=3). No mismatch.
deliverable_summary: 1 P1 (cross-validated with RED), 2 P2 (architecture consistency), 1 P3 (testability). All inventory entries accounted for; mutex/onOneServer 100% covered; retry/DLQ patterns are well-formed for the 3 ShouldQueue Jobs. Wave G + Wave 3 heals are correctly applied to the COMMAND lanes they targeted but did not propagate to TWO sibling sites (SloEvaluatorJob branch selector + StockScanRupture branch selector), which is the highest-value finding from this audit.
